Rooms.Name: Waiting Room
Rooms.Description:
Adrenaline surges through your veins as the anticipation of battle 
and death builds.A sign hangs from the wall, look at it if you aren't 
familiar with this style of battle. Only one of you will leave alive, 
so prepare now, and fight well. A doorway will lead upwards when 
the battle begins.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These will be instructions when the zone is complete. (Mental note:
must put a door in here :P)

Rooms.Name: Middle Level Of the Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
The battle begins, and the time for strategy is now. You can go up, 
to the open hallways, for sniping. Or you can go down, into the dank 
catacombs of the Arena, where sight and movement are impaired. Or, 
you can just stay on the middle level. Exits leave in all directions 
except south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
Footsteps echo all around you, and you wonder how near your 
adversary is. Not too near, you hope. This room is bare, save for 
the evidence of battle, and exits leave in all directions save for 
south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - SouthEast Corner
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself cornered here, yet you can use it to your 
advantage, if you so choose. This room is bare and reasonably 
well-lit, allowing you to see the bloodstains and holes in the wall. 
Exits are in all directions except south and east.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
As is the motif here, this room is bare, with light entering from 
above. Fin d your opponent, and slay him! Exits lead in all directions,
 except south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - SouthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
You are in the corner of the arena, more vulnerable than in most 
places, yet also in a fair position to set an ambush. Exits lead in
all directions, except south and west.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
This room, like all others on this level, is bare. Exits lead in 
all directions, and you find yourself wishing for the security of a 
wall at your back.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
This well-lit room is close to the center of the Arena, bloodstains 
attest to the danger of having exits, and entryways, in all directions. 
If you dont have eyes in the back of your head, you had better find a 
more defensible position.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
You feel more secure with a solid wall at your back. Echoes of 
footsteps ring all around you, yet you cannot tell in what direction. 
Exits, however, lead in all directions except east, so you could try 
to find out......

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
Once again, a pretty bare room, littered with some broken crossbow 
bolts, and as usual, some dried blood. Exits lead in every direction.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
Again, you feel secure without a potential sniper at your back. The
worn stone floors of this room are spattered with drops of blood from 
wounded players. Exits lead in every direction except east.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - NorthEast Corner
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, the pitted floors seem more 
worn than the rest, attesting to the fact that some combatants use 
this room often, for whatever reason. Exits lead in all directions 
except north and east.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
Little furnishings and bloodstained, pockmarked walls make this 
a dreary room.Exits lead in all directions except for north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
The battle begins, and the time for strategy is now. You can go 
up, to the open hallways, for sniping. Or you can go down, into the 
dank catacombs of the Arena, where sight and movement are impaired. 
Or, you can just stay on the middle level. Exits leave in all 
directions except north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
The sound of shuffling feet fills your ears, but you cant place the 
sound. It sounds like someone who is trying to walk softly, with little
success. Exits lead everywhere but north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - NorthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
Bones litter the ground beneath your feet, step carefully, your 
opponent will no doubt hear the crunching of bones beneath your feet. 
Another corner room, and exits going everywhere but north and west.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - SouthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
This room is dark, dank, and cluttered. Bones and other assorted 
junk is strewn across the floor, making accurate and quick movement 
impossible.Exits from this corner lead in all directions but west, 
south, and down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
Rooms.Description:
Unidentifiable sounds fill the air, making you very jumpy and wary. 
Your only comfort is that to find you, your opponent must subject 
himself to same confusing catacombs. Exits lead everywhere but south 
and down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
Rooms.Description:
The heat and humidity make your eyes water, and the constant 
thundering sounds distract you from proper concentration. Clutter 
surrounds the exits that lead everywhere except south and down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
Rooms.Description:
You stumble around this filthy and bleak room for a moment, before 
finding the exits that lead everywhere but down and south.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - SouthEast Corner
Rooms.Description:
The sweltering heat combined with the smell of death makes for a 
nauseating combination as you stumble into this corner room. Exits lead
everywhere but down, south, and east.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
Stifling heat and steam cloud your vision, blood and gore stays 
moist and quickly decomposes down here. Exits lead everywhere but down
and east.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
Rooms.Description:
Sweat drips into your eyes, and the stinging forces you to blink 
repeatedly. The blink of an eye is more than enough time to catch a 
crossbow bolt between the eyes....Wipe the sweat from your brow and 
leave through an exit that leads anywhere but down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
Rooms.Description:
Sounds assail your ears, and the heat makes your head throb. How 
much longer can you remain down here? There is an exit that leads up, 
as well as to the 4 cardinal directions.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
Rooms.Description:
Your head swims, your vision is blurry, in this state, your 
vulnerability is clear. But will the other combatants pursue you into
this hellhole? You may soon find out. In the meantime, however, you
can leave in every direction but down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
A wall at your back calms you down, but just barely. Your eyesight 
is almost useless, as is your hearing. You may want to stumble through 
an exit that leads to all directions but down and west, but who knows 
where you'll end up.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - NorthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, did you come here on purpose? 
Who knows, your mind plays tricks on you due to the constant assaults 
on your senses. Exits lead everywhere but down, north, and west.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
Rooms.Description:
The clutter becomes impassable to some directions, bones and junk 
line the walls. You can stagger in any direction but north and down.

Exits.Description: This large pile of crap could be obscuring something.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
Rooms.Description:
Your only consolation is that your opponent is experiencing the 
same agony as yourself. That is, of course, if he is down here. If 
not, well, then all this agony is for naught. Exits lead everywhere 
but north and down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
Rooms.Description:
The pain you experience down here is nothing compared to the pain 
of a bolt drilling into your chest. The clutter parts to reveal exits 
to everywhere, save for north and down.

Rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - NorthEast Corner
Rooms.Description:
You have a tactical advantage over your opponents by being down 
here, though that is little comfort against the crashing sounds and 
stinging, acrid steam. Exits from this corner lead everywhere but down,
north, and east.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Southeast Corner
Rooms.Description:
The fresh air masks the real menace of this upper level. You are 
extremely vulnerable from all directions, then again, so are your 
opponents, if they choose to brave this veritable shooting gallery. 
Exits lead everywhere but up, south, and east.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
The sky is above you, escape from this deathtrap seems almost 
possible. Think again, the walls are three times as tall as you are, 
and slick with blood. Exits lead everywhere but up and south.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
These hallways are bare, save for glorious paintings of opponents 
past, most are blood-smeared or damaged. The hallway leads everywhere 
but up and south, and trapdoors go down in every room.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
Rooms.Description:
The walls, underneath the gristle and sun-dried blood, are made 
of stone, and and inscription is carved here. Exits lead everywhere, 
except up and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You may find it worth your while to stop and examine your 
surroundings from time to time, you may find an exceptional tactical 
advantage. Be sure not to stop too long, or you remains too, will 
litter this arena.....

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - SouthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, and a femur lies at your feet,
surrounded by scattering of smaller bones. You can lie in wait here, 
or you can move on, through exits to all directions but up, south, and
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small carving on this femur, it reads as follows:

          #wZone by Kurrelgyre, Hope you like it!:)#N

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
The west wall is smooth and stained, save for a crossbow bolt 
stuck into the wall at angle. Exits lead everywhere but up and west.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
These rooms are weather-worn, but fresh-smelling from the 
constant influx of air. The smell of death remains, however. 
Exits lead everywhere but up.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
You're extremely vulnerable here, a well-aimed shot could take you 
down from any of the four directions, and someone can come from below 
and take you by surprise.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
Rooms.Description:
The center of the upper arena could very well be the most 
indefensible area in the arena, you may want to move around often, 
at they very least. Exits lead in every direction but up.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central Edge
Rooms.Description:
A nice, seemingly solid wall is on the eastern wall of this room. A 
skull, held fast by a rusty bolt, adorns the center of the wall. Exits 
lead to victory or death in every direction but up, and east.

Exits.Description: Perhaps this skull has something to offer.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - NorthEast Corner
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, the air rushes in from above, 
obscuring any sounds you might otherwise hear. You can wedge yourself 
into the corner and wait, or you can exit in any direction but up, 
north, and east.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
Blood streaks the floor here, it glistens, and reveals its freshness.
Exits go everywhere but up and north.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
A corpse lies here, dessicated by the sun and dry air from above. 
It looks as if this combatant had a painful death. Leave this corpse 
behind, and go in any direction but up and north.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
Rooms.Description:
The wind whistles through the hallways atop the arena, and you 
can't hear much from below. Could your opponent be drawing a bead on 
you as you stand here, listening? Move quickly, and leave in any 
direction but up and north.

Rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - NorthWest Corner
Rooms.Description:
Rusted items of useless equipment litter the floor of this corner 
room, most with neat little holes in them, just about the size of a 
crossbow bolt. Leave anywhere buy up, north, and east.

Rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
This small alcove is a brief respite from the acrid air of the 
catacombs.The air in here is cooler and less foul. You can lie in 
wait for your opponent here, or, if you're a pessimist, consider 
yourself trapped.

Exits.Description: This vent allows air to pass into the chamber.

Rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove on the Middle Level
Rooms.Description:
You can rest here, and catch your breath, but pray your opponents 
dont get the same idea....

Rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove among the Open-air Hallways
Rooms.Description:
This little room offers a supreme place to snipe an unknowing 
opponent. A stench wafts in from someplace, making it less than ideal
to sit here.

Exits.Description: This vent allows air to pass into the chamber.

Rooms.Name: The Spectators Room for the Arena
Rooms.Description:
This room was created for the amusement of the spectators watching 
the fights to the death contained within the Arena. While spectators 
rarely get a glimpse of the frenzied combatants, from this room they 
can shout encouragement, and hear the agonized screams of the dying.

Rooms.Name: Waiting room
Rooms.Description:
Adrenaline surges through your veins as the anticipation of 
battle and death builds. A sign is etched into the wall. Read it 
if you aren't familiar with the art of the crossbow. Only one of 
you will leave alive, so prepare now, and fight well. A doorway will 
lead upwards when the battle begins.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This will be instructions when the code is complete.

Objects.Name: board bulletin arena
Objects.Description: An arena board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.
